project_type: Full-stack React + Express TypeScript web application
build_system: Vite + Express with tsx for server-side dev, esbuild for production
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install. 2. Run npm run lint (tsc --noEmit). 3. Run npm run dev and verify server starts on port 3000.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js v22 available. npm/pnpm/yarn available.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - no contribution guide. Follow user spec exactly.
key_patterns: React 18+ with Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide React icons, motion/react for animations, Express backend with Vite dev middleware, bilingual Marathi/English UI, role-based access control, mock data layer (no real DB connections)
directory_structure: Root: package.json, vite.config.ts, server.ts, tsconfig.json, index.html, .env.example. src/: main.tsx, App.tsx, types/index.ts, data/mockData.ts, data/prdData.ts, components/*.tsx
